name: vLLM-XPU on Max 1550: Meta-Llama-3-8B FP16 b64 128io throughput
methodology: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench (arXiv:2411.00136), Intel Max 1550 (Ponte Vecchio). vLLM 0.5.2-XPU FP16, batch 64, 128in/128out. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/latency (Eq.2). AGGREGATE across batch.
notes: Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 (128GB HBM2e). First measured record on xpu-intel-dc-gpu-max-1550.
